description: Use this when the user wants FPL Cat to remember their Fantasy Premier League team, change the saved one or forget it: 'remember my team 123456', 'my team ID is 123456', 'change my saved team', 'forget my team'. Saves the team ID to their FPL Cat account (the client asks them to sign in first), so team tools work without it later. The first team ID a signed-in user gives any team tool is saved automatically; use this to change or forget it.

team.description: The user's FPL team ID: the number after /entry/ in the address of their FPL Points page (fantasy.premierleague.com/entry/1234567/event/6). The whole link works too. Once the user has given it, reuse it for every later question in this conversation; don't ask again.

name: set_my_team
title: Save my FPL team
